protocol.languageCoverage: 4 bilingual/Chinese documents; remaining English prose or structured extracted text
protocol.scope: Text-level reasoning; not PDF/DOCX/OCR ingestion or real hiring outcomes.
protocol.primary: Checked pipeline four-class accuracy and macro F1; report rules and raw model on same documents.
protocol.intervals: No independence interval: paired requirements within documents and synthetic selection.
